projects.title: Tokyo Neon Nights — Cinematic Teaser
projects.description: High-energy rhythm cut with stylized neon color grading, custom sound design, and speed ramping for a street motorsport short.
projects.fullDescription: A fast-paced promotional video blending atmospheric midnight street cinematography with bass-heavy sound design. Utilized custom DaVinci Resolve node trees for neon split-toning and Premiere Pro dynamic transitions.

projects.title: Cyber Renaissance — Surreal Retouch
projects.description: A complex 18-layer digital composite fusing classical Renaissance portraiture with futuristic cybernetic augmentations and neon luminescence.
projects.fullDescription: Constructed over 14 hours in Photoshop, this project involved meticulous skin texture reconstruction, custom lighting passes to blend robotic components, and subtle atmospheric dust particles.

projects.title: Origins — Film Poster & Key Art
projects.description: Theatrical release poster featuring dramatic negative space, custom editorial typography, and high-contrast dual-tone lighting.
projects.fullDescription: Designed for an independent nature and astronomy documentary. The goal was to evoke wonder and isolation using monolithic layout hierarchy, deep textured grain, and refined Swiss typography.

projects.title: Aether Streetwear — Commercial Reel
projects.description: Snappy, 9:16 vertical commercial video crafted for social channels with kinetic typography and sync-to-beat audio cuts.
projects.fullDescription: Tailored for Instagram Reels and TikTok ad placement. Every frame was cut to mirror the rhythm of the custom UK garage beat, driving 3.2M impressions and a 28% click-through spike for the fashion line.

projects.title: Vogue Noir — Editorial Color Grade
projects.description: Intimate high-fashion lookbook retouching featuring filmic grain, subtle skin micro-contrast, and luxurious monochromatic tonal curves.
projects.fullDescription: Worked directly with photographer raw files to deliver 24 magazine spreads. Applied non-destructive dodge & burn alongside tailored 3D LUT curves for timeless print quality.

projects.title: Overdrive EP — Album & Identity
projects.description: Complete visual identity for an electronic music release including vinyl sleeve, animated Spotify Canvas, and promotional assets.
projects.fullDescription: Created an evocative 80s retro-futuristic emblem combined with holographic foil styling and custom 3D wireframes. Delivered in print-ready CMYK and high-res digital display standards.

projects.title: Apex Championship — YouTube Package
projects.description: High-CTR 3D YouTube thumbnails, banner pack, and stream starting screens engineered for maximum gamer audience engagement.
projects.fullDescription: Optimized thumbnail templates that boosted video click-through rates by 42%. Features custom 3D lighting, dynamic action cuts, and punchy expression isolation.

projects.title: Summit Silence — Mountain Doc Short
projects.description: Atmospheric, slow-burn documentary cut featuring drone footage color matched with vintage 16mm archival film inserts.
projects.fullDescription: Edited a 5-minute showcase film for an outdoor equipment brand. Focus was on immersive nature sound design, spatial audio transitions, and natural cold-tone color grades.

about.description: I'm Darshan G Poojari, a passionate video editor and multimedia designer from Sirsi, Karnataka. With a background in multimedia production, technical computing, and cloud workflows, I create cinematic edits, high-quality retouched visuals, and impactful graphic designs.
about.story:
Looking forward to contributing with dedication, passion, and creative technical skills. My creative journey combines multimedia craftsmanship with a solid technical foundation in computer systems and digital media.

Based in Bisalakoppa, Sirsi (Karnataka, India), I focus on transforming raw footage and creative concepts into engaging visual stories through rhythm, color grading, sound design, and graphic key art.

From dynamic video edits and promotional reels to detailed photo retouching and graphic branding, I bring precision, dedication, and creativity to every project.

experience.description: Editing cinematic video shorts, reels, photo manipulation, and custom graphic designs for creators and digital campaigns.
Technical coursework covering computer networking, cloud computing (AWS S3), frontend scripting (HTML, CSS), Python, and multimedia systems.
